```text
# #5117: CI: daily super run failed
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

[super run 45885043587](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45885043587) on `_staging` (`04c800b`, workflow_dispatch) failed:

| Job | Result |
|---|---|
| [fuzz (3/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45885043587/job/140136856502) | failure |

Each link opens that job's log. This issue stays open while the run is red and the next run that passes every job closes it. `gh workflow run super.yml --ref <branch>` runs it again on demand.

Night bot: this run is on `_staging`, so it is yours, and it comes first (`priority:high`, and you take it before every other queued item): production promotes itself only from a daily run on `_staging` that passes every job, so it waits on this fix, and `_staging` holds still until this issue closes (scripts/promote-staging.sh, the freeze). Fix every failed job here, in the one pull request on `main` that closes this: when it closes, `_staging` takes main's first green commit after the close and the super run starts on it at once, and a run still red opens a new issue. Before you start, look for an open pull request or issue already fixing one of these jobs, and build on it instead of fixing the same test twice. Root-cause each failed job from its log and fix it in a pull request: a flake is not a root cause, so make a flaky test robust instead of re-running it, and never skip, disable or quarantine a test to get green. Reproduce it with the job's own command (CLAUDE.md, Commands; one fuzz seed is `cargo jackioh fuzz --from <seed> --seeds 1`, with `--handicap` for the handicapped wave and `--duos` for the Duos wave; a daily test is `cargo test -p <crate> <name> -- --ignored`). A pull request's CI runs only the e2e smoke specs and leaves the tests marked `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` out, so say in the pull request which job here the fix makes pass and how you checked it. You cannot change `.github/`: make the part of the fix that lives elsewhere, and when the rest needs a workflow or an action, give the exact lines to change there and ask a person to make them.

---
_Posted by `.github/workflows/super.yml`._
```

- No log access: must reproduce. Building release jackioh-tools (in progress).

## Next
- Run shard 3's seeds on HEAD (and on 04c800b if HEAD is green) to find the failing seed(s).
- Release binary at $CARGO_TARGET_DIR/release/jackioh (CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/runner/work/JackiOh/JackiOh/target, shared).
- Running /tmp/fz/run.sh (plain, handicap, duos for shard 3) on HEAD; logs /tmp/fz/{plain,handicap,duos}.log (started 20:50).
- Expected ~15 min per 1v1 wave, ~5 min Duos (seed_watch.rs timings).
- HEAD plain wave 8401..12600: 4200 passed, 0 failed (1187 s). So the red wave was handicap or Duos.
- Handicap wave on HEAD running (/tmp/fz/handicap.log), then Duos.
- Building 04c800b (git archive → /tmp/old/src, CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/old/target, nice) to reproduce
  there too: #5100 changed the AI (crates/ai/src/decide.rs, reply.rs, config.rs), so handicapped games
  differ between 04c800b and HEAD; the engine/cards diffs since are text only.

## FOUND (HEAD c5ba7cef34)
- Handicapped seed 9498 fails: `I21 Spell reached Immune to Spells: destroyed names c21 (stinkyscapeplus-111, p1's)
  on turn 28 in t-13:stinkyscapeplus-121+stinkyscape-126's run (§6.1, R4453000)` (medium p2, start last-boards).
  Reproduce: `$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/release/jackioh fuzz --from 9498 --seeds 1 --handicap`.
- Cause: p2's C+ #31 Fusion Lab fused S+ #121 Toxopid into S #126 (a Spell, the kept card → fused type Spell,
  fuse.rs `fused_type`). The Spell's `cry` runs Toxopid's Cry (R5048000): `crush` (crates/engine/src/effects/destroy.rs)
  marks every Unit in the drawn zone with no `restrictions::unaffected_by` check, so a Spell destroyed S+ #111 Mace
  (Immune to Spells). R4453000: a Spell passes an immune field Unit by "whatever its wording" → engine bug, monitor right.
- Fix: in `crush`, skip `crate::restrictions::unaffected_by(ctx, &card)` (like buff.rs buff_all_units, move_.rs).
  Zone keeps the Unit → not free → no Leg (as Indestructible, R5048000 test r5048000_a_unit_its_crush_cannot_destroy…).
- Precedent: R4599000 (Call to Chaos switch, fuzz seed 2071, new ruling per case), spell_verbs.rs `allured_by` pattern.
- Ruling: R5117000 (issue #5117 block). pending para in spec/pending/5117.md. §6.3 Crush row + §6.1 Immune row link it.
- Plain wave HEAD: green. Duos HEAD: running. 04c800b build in /tmp/old (to check its own failing seed).
- HEAD shard 3 complete: plain 4200/4200 green, handicap 4199/4200 (seed 9498 only), Duos 500/500 green.
- Scratch fix copy: /tmp/fix/src (HEAD + crush unaffected_by), building into /tmp/fix/target, to rerun seed 9498 + shard-3 handicap.
- Tests planned: spell_verbs.rs mod r5117000_… (crush applied as Spell vs Unit source, `allured_by` pattern);
  c121_toxopid.rs r5117000_… (fuse_cards defIds [ID] intoInstanceId Radiant "stand-in (0) Spell", play it, immune stand-in in P2 lane 1).
- VERIFIED: /tmp/fix binary (HEAD + crush fix): seed 9498 --handicap passes. /tmp/old (04c800b) binary: seed 9498
  --handicap fails with the identical I21 message → the job's failure is this seed. Fuzz waves use no crates/ai
  (handicap is the engine's AI_DIFFICULTY handicap), so 04c800b ≡ HEAD for shard 3's games.
- spell_verbs.rs is in the rules_3 test binary. Drafted tests in /tmp/fixparts/{engine_test.rs,card_test.rs};
  compiling them in /tmp/fix (debug) to check they pass with the fix.
- Correction: which card made the fusion is NOT traced (C+ #31 is only a guess from p2's deck); the ruling must
  not name it. Certain: the fused id holds S+ #121 + S #126 and I21 read its run as a Spell's.
- classify check pending: throwaway clone /tmp/cls (fix committed there), parent-bin = $CARGO_TARGET_DIR/release/jackioh.
- Files: destroy.rs (crush), spell_verbs.rs (test), c121_toxopid.rs (test), spec/rulings/R5117000.md (new),
  spec/pending/5117.md (new), spec/06-keywords/6.3-actions-and-verbs.md (Crush row). Fragment only if classify asks.
